series.title: 3 bag thefts in 22 min across 3 areas
series.reading: Every gap could be walked: one offender or one crew is a working hypothesis, not a finding. ARGUS links behaviour, place and time; it never identifies people.

areas.why: 1:29 on foot · criticality 0.9 · no camera sees it

watch.basis: Offences like this cluster in space and time (near-repeat). The whole site is within 2:36 on foot, so for 30 min after INC-0007 every area is in reach; areas are ranked by criticality, nearness and how recent it was. A prompt for attention, not a prediction of a crime.
